name: CTM Taipa / Macao Telecommunications Data Center
notes: Macao telecom regulator lists CTM authorization no. 1/2024 to install and operate data centers renewed from 2025-10-01 to 2027-09-30; Macao Magazine reports CTM already has its own data centre in Taipa and a Hong Kong backup. No public MW capacity found.

name: MTel Data Center
notes: Operator cloud-services page states MTel Data Center provides cloud services, an international-standard operating environment, professional management/monitoring, and Macau local POP service for virtual-server offerings. No public MW capacity found.

name: China Telecom Macau Data Center authorization
notes: Macao telecom regulator lists Despacho do Chefe do Executivo n.º 258/2025 authorizing China Telecom (Macau) Company Limited to install and operate a data center. Public source does not identify site, capacity, or opening date.

name: IAM Municipal Affairs Bureau modular data center
notes: Huawei case study says IAM needed to build a new data center in its new office to support e-Government Cloud services, using Huawei FusionModule 2000 modular data center infrastructure. Vendor case-study evidence; no public MW capacity found.
